title: Story: When Steve tried to hire me I said, " I don't like having a ...
speaker: Steve Jobs
event: When Steve tried to hire me I said...
content:
When Steve tried to hire me I said, " I don't like having a boss."
He said, "A lot of people say working for me is like not having a boss."
Yes, it's a true story.
full_transcript:
When Steve tried to hire me I said, " I don't like having a boss."
He said, "A lot of people say working for me is like not having a boss."
Yes, it's a true story.
